data.needsFromBrand: Does the brand state that the ink flows consistently without skipping or clogging?
Does the brand state that the ink is smudge-free or smear-resistant?
Does the brand state how long the ink lasts?
Does the brand state that the ink dries quickly or provide a dry time?
Does the brand state if the pen is refillable and with which refills?
Does the brand state whether the ink bleeds through paper?
Does the brand state information about the durability of the pen body or tip?
